81a20d1c920cc6e3.en: Sentence-transformers all-mpnet-base-v2 is a sentence embedding model based on MPNet architecture. It generates dense vector representations for sentences and texts. The model was trained on multiple datasets including MS MARCO, NLI, and other text similarity corpora. It supports semantic search, text similarity, and clustering tasks. The embeddings capture semantic meaning and can be used for various natural language processing applications requiring sentence-level representations.
81a20d1c920cc6e3.zh: Sentence-transformers all-mpnet-base-v2 是一个基于MPNet架构的句子嵌入模型。它为句子和文本生成密集向量表示。该模型在多个数据集上训练，包括MS MARCO、NLI和其他文本相似性语料库。支持语义搜索、文本相似性和聚类任务。嵌入捕获语义含义，可用于需要句子级表示的各种自然语言处理应用。

d02457942f7a8a8c.en: Pyannote speaker-diarization-3.1 is an audio processing pipeline for speaker diarization. It identifies and segments different speakers in audio recordings, detecting speaker changes and voice activity. The system handles overlapped speech detection and supports automatic speech recognition integration. Licensed under MIT and compatible with endpoints, it provides complete speaker diarization capabilities for multi-speaker audio analysis and transcription applications.
d02457942f7a8a8c.zh: Pyannote speaker-diarization-3.1 是一个用于说话人日志的音频处理流水线。它识别和分割录音中的不同说话人，检测说话人变化和语音活动。该系统处理重叠语音检测并支持自动语音识别集成。采用MIT许可证并与端点兼容，为多说话人音频分析和转录应用提供完整的说话人日志功能。
d02457942f7a8a8c.es: Pyannote speaker-diarization-3.1 is an audio processing pipeline for speaker diarization. It identifies and segments different speakers in audio recordings, detecting speaker changes and voice activity. The system handles overlapped speech detection and supports automatic speech recognition integration. Licensed under MIT and compatible with endpoints, it provides complete speaker diarization capabilities for multi-speaker audio analysis and transcription applications.

aa916aa3bce83f1d.en: Bingsu adetailer is an image processing tool for detail enhancement and analysis. It utilizes datasets including anime segmentation and wider face for training. The model supports various image processing tasks and is built with PyTorch framework. Licensed under Apache 2.0, it provides detail enhancement capabilities for image analysis applications. The tool focuses on improving image details and supports ultralytics integration for computer vision tasks.
aa916aa3bce83f1d.zh: Bingsu adetailer 是一个用于细节增强和分析的图像处理工具。它利用包括动漫分割和更广泛人脸在内的数据集进行训练。该模型支持各种图像处理任务，并使用PyTorch框架构建。采用Apache 2.0许可证，为图像分析应用提供细节增强能力。该工具专注于改善图像细节，并支持ultralytics集成以用于计算机视觉任务。

The model supports various image processing tasks and is built with PyTorch framework. Licensed under Apache 2.0, it provides detail enhancement capabilities for image analysis applications. The tool focuses on improving image details and supports ultralytics integration for computer vision tasks.

e353478fe3691a43.en: CLIP-ViT-Base-Patch32 is a vision-language model developed by OpenAI that connects images and text. It uses a Vision Transformer architecture with patch size 32 and is trained on 400 million image-text pairs. The model enables zero-shot image classification by comparing image features with text descriptions. It supports multiple frameworks including PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX, and is compatible with Transformers library. Based on research from papers arXiv:1908.04913 and arXiv:2103.00020.
e353478fe3691a43.zh: CLIP-ViT-Base-Patch32是由OpenAI开发的视觉语言模型，连接图像和文本。采用Vision Transformer架构，补丁大小为32，在4亿个图像-文本对上训练。该模型通过比较图像特征与文本描述实现零样本图像分类。支持PyTorch、TensorFlow和JAX等多种框架，并与Transformers库兼容。基于arXiv:1908.04913和arXiv:2103.00020论文研究，具备端点兼容性，适用于视觉任务和跨模态理解。

60db054049e727ad.en: RoBERTa-Large is a large-scale language model developed by Facebook AI, optimized from BERT architecture. It removes next sentence prediction and uses dynamic masking during training. Trained on BookCorpus and English Wikipedia datasets, it has 355 million parameters. The model supports masked language modeling and is compatible with multiple frameworks including PyTorch, JAX, and ONNX. Based on research from papers arXiv:1806.02847 and arXiv:1907.11692, licensed under MIT for research and commercial use.
60db054049e727ad.zh: RoBERTa-Large是由Facebook AI开发的大规模语言模型，基于BERT架构优化。移除了下一句预测任务，采用动态掩码训练策略。在BookCorpus和英文维基百科数据集上训练，包含3.55亿参数。支持掩码语言建模任务，兼容PyTorch、JAX、ONNX等多种框架。基于arXiv:1806.02847和arXiv:1907.11692论文研究，采用MIT许可证，适用于研究和商业用途，具备端点兼容性和自动训练功能。

0682a892e2c13e23.en: GPT-2 is a transformer-based language model developed by OpenAI for text generation. It uses decoder-only architecture with 1.5 billion parameters and was trained on WebText dataset containing 8 million web pages. The model generates coherent text continuations and supports various text generation tasks. It's compatible with multiple frameworks including PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, and ONNX, and works with Transformers library. Licensed under MIT, it's widely used for natural language processing research and applications.
0682a892e2c13e23.zh: GPT-2是由OpenAI开发的基于Transformer的文本生成语言模型。采用仅解码器架构，包含15亿参数，在包含800万个网页的WebText数据集上训练。该模型能够生成连贯的文本续写，支持多种文本生成任务。兼容PyTorch、TensorFlow、JAX、ONNX等多种框架，并与Transformers库集成。采用MIT许可证，广泛应用于自然语言处理研究和应用领域，具备端点兼容性和文本生成推理功能。

57b588580194e149.en: RoBERTa-Base is a robustly optimized BERT pretraining approach developed by Facebook AI. It removes next sentence prediction objective and uses larger batches with more training data. With 125 million parameters, it's trained on BookCorpus and English Wikipedia datasets. The model excels at masked language modeling and supports multiple frameworks including PyTorch, JAX, and TensorFlow. Based on research from papers arXiv:1806.02847 and arXiv:1907.11692, licensed under MIT for both research and commercial applications.
57b588580194e149.zh: RoBERTa-Base是由Facebook AI开发的鲁棒优化BERT预训练方法。移除了下一句预测目标，采用更大批次和更多训练数据。包含1.25亿参数，在BookCorpus和英文维基百科数据集上训练。该模型擅长掩码语言建模任务，支持PyTorch、JAX、TensorFlow等多种框架。基于arXiv:1806.02847和arXiv:1907.11692论文研究，采用MIT许可证，适用于研究和商业应用，具备端点兼容性和自动训练功能。

f5bb4e90d8f915fe.en: DistilBERT-Base-Uncased is a distilled version of BERT that retains 97% of BERT's performance while being 40% smaller and 60% faster. Developed by Hugging Face, it has 66 million parameters and is trained on BookCorpus and Wikipedia. The model supports masked language modeling and is optimized for efficiency. Compatible with PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX frameworks, it's licensed under Apache 2.0. Based on research from paper arXiv:1910.01108, designed for resource-constrained environments.
f5bb4e90d8f915fe.zh: DistilBERT-Base-Uncased是BERT的蒸馏版本，在保持97%性能的同时，模型大小减少40%，速度提升60%。由Hugging Face开发，包含6600万参数，在BookCorpus和维基百科数据集上训练。支持掩码语言建模任务，针对效率进行优化。兼容PyTorch、TensorFlow和JAX框架，采用Apache 2.0许可证。基于arXiv:1910.01108论文研究，专为资源受限环境设计，具备端点兼容性和自动训练功能。

2ca44f4b84f26858.en: Tarsier2-Recap-7B is a 7-billion parameter video language model developed by Omni Research for video understanding and summarization. Based on research from paper arXiv:2501.07888, it processes video content to generate textual summaries and descriptions. The model uses safetensors format and is licensed under Apache 2.0. Designed for video analysis tasks, it represents recent advancements in multimodal AI combining visual and language processing capabilities for comprehensive video content understanding.

79619011609dd378.en: This multilingual sentence embedding model generates semantic representations for text in over 50 languages. Based on MiniLM architecture with 12 transformer layers, it converts sentences into 384-dimensional vectors optimized for semantic similarity. Its primary purpose is cross-lingual semantic search, text clustering, and paraphrase identification. Core capabilities include handling multiple languages within a unified vector space and supporting tasks like information retrieval and duplicate detection. Strengths include efficient performance, broad language coverage, and consistent embedding quality across languages. Typical use cases span multilingual search engines, content recommendation systems, and document similarity analysis.
79619011609dd378.zh: 该多语言句子嵌入模型可为超过50种语言的文本生成语义向量表示。基于12层Transformer的MiniLM架构，将句子转换为384维向量，专门优化语义相似性计算。主要用途包括跨语言语义搜索、文本聚类和复述识别。核心能力体现在统一向量空间中处理多种语言，支持信息检索和重复检测等任务。优势在于高效性能、广泛语言覆盖以及跨语言一致的嵌入质量。典型应用场景涵盖多语言搜索引擎、内容推荐系统和文档相似性分析，适用于需要处理多语言文本的各类

301671a7dd815b0e.en: This Vision Transformer model specializes in facial expression classification, trained to recognize human emotions from images. It identifies seven core expressions: anger, disgust, fear, happiness, neutrality, sadness, and surprise. The model leverages transformer architecture for robust feature extraction from facial images. Key strengths include high accuracy in expression detection and compatibility with multiple deployment formats including ONNX and PyTorch. Typical applications include emotion analysis in psychology research, user experience testing, and human-computer interaction systems where automated facial expression recognition is required.
301671a7dd815b0e.zh: 该视觉变换器模型专门用于面部表情分类，能够从图像中识别人类情绪。模型可检测七种核心表情：愤怒、厌恶、恐惧、快乐、中性、悲伤和惊讶。采用变换器架构实现对面部图像的稳健特征提取。主要优势包括表情检测的高准确性，以及支持ONNX和PyTorch等多种部署格式。典型应用场景涵盖心理学研究中的情绪分析、用户体验测试和人机交互系统，适用于需要自动化面部表情识别的各种场合。模型基于Apache 2.0开源协议，具备良好的兼容性和部署灵活性。

e95f7b03566c36de.en: OPT-125m is a 125 million parameter decoder-only transformer developed by Meta AI for open research. Based on GPT-3 architecture, it generates coherent text through autoregressive prediction. The model was trained on diverse English text corpora including books, web content, and news articles. Its compact size makes it suitable for research prototyping, educational demonstrations, and computational resource-constrained environments. Typical applications include text completion, dialogue simulation, and basic language understanding tasks. The model supports multiple frameworks including PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX.
e95f7b03566c36de.zh: OPT-125m是Meta AI开发的1.25亿参数仅解码器Transformer模型，专为开放研究设计。基于GPT-3架构，通过自回归预测生成连贯文本。模型在多样化英语语料库上训练，包含书籍、网页内容和新闻文章。其紧凑规模适合研究原型开发、教育演示和计算资源受限环境。典型应用包括文本补全、对话模拟和基础语言理解任务。支持PyTorch、TensorFlow和JAX多种框架，便于学术实验和算法验证。该模型为研究社区提供可复现的大语言模型基准。

416fe4f66b9ea10b.en: Contriever is a dense retrieval model developed by Facebook AI that learns text representations without human-labeled query-document pairs. It employs contrastive learning with data augmentation techniques to create meaningful embeddings. The model is based on BERT architecture and compatible with Transformers library. Core capabilities include semantic similarity search and information retrieval. Strengths include unsupervised training approach and robust performance across domains. Typical use cases involve document retrieval, semantic search systems, and content recommendation engines where labeled training data is scarce.
416fe4f66b9ea10b.zh: Contriever是由Facebook AI开发的密集检索模型，采用对比学习技术，无需人工标注的查询-文档对即可学习文本表示。该模型基于BERT架构，通过数据增强方法生成有意义的嵌入向量。核心能力包括语义相似性搜索和信息检索，优势在于无监督训练方法和跨领域的稳健性能。典型应用场景包括文档检索系统、语义搜索引擎以及内容推荐平台，特别适用于标注训练数据稀缺的情况。模型兼容Transformers库，支持多种下游任务部署。
416fe4f66b9ea10b.es: Contriever is a dense retrieval model developed by Facebook AI that learns text representations without human-labeled query-document pairs. It employs contrastive learning with data augmentation techniques to create meaningful embeddings. The model is based on BERT architecture and compatible with Transformers library. Core capabilities include semantic similarity search and information retrieval. Strengths include unsupervised training approach and robust performance across domains. 37516410e8df8646.en: XLM-RoBERTa-base is a multilingual language model developed by Facebook AI for cross-lingual understanding tasks. It builds upon RoBERTa architecture and was trained on 2.5TB of CommonCrawl data across 100 languages. Core capabilities include text classification, named entity recognition, and question answering across multiple languages without language-specific training. Key strengths are its strong cross-lingual transfer performance and consistent representation across languages. Typical use cases include multilingual content moderation, cross-lingual search, and international customer support automation.
37516410e8df8646.zh: XLM-RoBERTa-base是由Facebook AI开发的多语言预训练模型，基于RoBERTa架构改进而成。该模型在涵盖100种语言的2.5TB CommonCrawl数据上训练，具备跨语言理解能力。核心功能包括多语言文本分类、命名实体识别和问答任务，无需针对特定语言进行专门训练。主要优势在于出色的跨语言迁移性能和语言间表示一致性。典型应用场景包括多语言内容审核、跨语言搜索引擎优化、国际客户服务自动化以及多语言文档分析处理，特别适合需要处理多种语言内容的企业级应用。
37516410e8df8646.es: XLM-RoBERTa-base is a multilingual language model developed by Facebook AI for cross-lingual understanding tasks. fc689989f3bd9fd4.en: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct is a 3-billion-parameter instruction-tuned language model designed for conversational AI applications. It excels in text generation tasks with strong reasoning capabilities and multilingual support. The model demonstrates efficient performance across various domains including question answering, content creation, and code generation. Built on the Qwen2.5 architecture, it offers improved instruction following while maintaining computational efficiency. Typical use cases include chatbots, virtual assistants, and automated content generation systems.
fc689989f3bd9fd4.zh: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct是一个拥有30亿参数的指令微调语言模型，专门设计用于对话式人工智能应用。该模型在文本生成任务中表现出色，具备强大的推理能力和多语言支持能力。基于Qwen2.5架构构建，在保持计算效率的同时提供了改进的指令遵循性能。核心优势包括高效的参数利用、稳定的对话生成和广泛的任务适应性。典型应用场景涵盖智能客服系统、虚拟助手、内容自动生成、问答系统以及代码辅助生成等多个领域，适用于需要自然语言交互的各种实际应用。

e9ea5daeb6b4f283.en: BERT-tiny is a compact BERT model designed for natural language inference tasks like MNLI, based on research from papers arXiv:1908.08962 and arXiv:2110.01518. It is a pre-trained transformer model implemented in PyTorch, compatible with Hugging Face endpoints, and licensed under MIT. With over 7.6 million downloads, it serves as a lightweight alternative for efficient NLP applications in English.
e9ea5daeb6b4f283.zh: BERT-tiny 是一个紧凑的 BERT 模型，专为自然语言推理任务（如 MNLI）设计，基于 arXiv:1908.08962 和 arXiv:2110.01518 论文研究。该模型采用 PyTorch 实现，预训练完成，兼容 Hugging Face 端点，使用 MIT 许可证。下载量超过 760 万，作为轻量级替代方案，适用于英语 NLP 应用，以提高效率。

3dac7d9bb405cedb.en: BGE-base-en-v1.5 is a BERT-based model for sentence similarity and text embedding extraction, developed by BAAI. It supports features like ONNX and SafeTensors, is compatible with AutoTrain and endpoints, and licensed under MIT. The model is trained on English data and integrates with MTEB benchmarks, with research cited from multiple arXiv papers including 2309.07597. It has over 7.6 million downloads.

d7d7aefb6cf65661.en: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct is an instruction-tuned language model by Meta, based on the Llama-3.1-8B base model. It is designed for conversational tasks in multiple languages including English, German, and Spanish, with research from arXiv:2204.05149. Licensed under Llama 3.1, it uses PyTorch and is compatible with endpoints, achieving over 7.1 million downloads. The model supports fine-tuning and autotrain compatibility.

486bfda226a0fe5a.en: ColBERTv2.0 is a neural retrieval model that enhances BERT for efficient information retrieval, using late interaction mechanisms. It uses Apache 2.0 license and has been downloaded over 5 million times. The model is optimized for English conversations.

87a51c1ff33fdda9.en: t5-small is the small variant of Google's T5 (Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer) model. It is a multilingual model trained on the C4 dataset supporting English, German, and French. The model follows text-to-text paradigm for various NLP tasks. It is compatible with PyTorch, JAX, and ONNX frameworks. Using Apache 2.0 license, it has been downloaded over 5 million times and is optimized for US region.
87a51c1ff33fdda9.zh: t5-small是谷歌T5（文本到文本转换Transformer）模型的小型版本，这是一个在多语言C4数据集上训练的模型，支持英语、德语和法语。该模型采用文本到文本范式处理各种自然语言处理任务，兼容PyTorch、JAX和ONNX框架，基于Apache 2.0许可证发布，下载量超过505万次，针对美国地区进行了优化。

5461b10da7a99717.en: Wan_2.2_ComfyUI_Repackaged is a diffusion model repackaged for ComfyUI framework. It is distributed as a single-file diffusion model and optimized for US region usage. The model has been downloaded over 5 million times and is specifically designed for compatibility with ComfyUI workflow system. It provides diffusion capabilities in a repackaged format for easier deployment.
5461b10da7a99717.zh: Wan_2.2_ComfyUI_Repackaged是为ComfyUI框架重新打包的扩散模型，以单文件扩散模型形式分发，针对美国地区使用进行了优化。该模型下载量已超过503万次，专门设计用于与ComfyUI工作流系统兼容，以重新打包格式提供扩散能力，便于部署和使用。

144042b03349bc70.en: BGE-small-en-v1.5 is a compact English sentence embedding model developed by BAAI. Based on BERT architecture, it generates dense vector representations for text similarity tasks. The model supports feature extraction and sentence similarity applications, with compatibility for PyTorch, ONNX, and text embeddings inference. It has been evaluated on MTEB benchmarks and is released under MIT license. The model demonstrates efficient performance in semantic search and retrieval applications.
144042b03349bc70.zh: BGE-small-en-v1.5是由北京智源人工智能研究院开发的紧凑型英语句子嵌入模型。基于BERT架构，该模型为文本相似性任务生成密集向量表示。支持特征提取和句子相似性应用，兼容PyTorch、ONNX和文本嵌入推理框架。已在MTEB基准测试中进行评估，采用MIT许可证发布。该模型在语义搜索和检索应用中表现出高效性能，适用于需要轻量级嵌入解决方案的场景。

6a19d29fa1dbc098.en: CLAP-HTSAT-fused is an audio-text fusion model developed by LAION that combines Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining with HTSAT architecture. The model learns joint representations between audio signals and text descriptions, enabling cross-modal understanding. It supports feature extraction tasks and is compatible with transformers framework. Released under Apache 2.0 license, the model facilitates applications in audio classification, retrieval, and multimodal learning where audio and text alignment is required.
6a19d29fa1dbc098.zh: CLAP-HTSAT-fused是由LAION开发的音频-文本融合模型，结合了对比语言-音频预训练与HTSAT架构。该模型学习音频信号和文本描述之间的联合表示，实现跨模态理解。支持特征提取任务，兼容transformers框架。采用Apache 2.0许可证发布，适用于音频分类、检索以及需要音频和文本对齐的多模态学习应用场景。该模型能够处理音频与文本之间的语义关联任务。

295815a5d14f52a7.en: Voice Activity Detection is an audio processing pipeline from pyannote that identifies speech segments in audio streams. The model detects when speech is present versus silence or background noise, supporting automatic speech recognition workflows. Trained on multiple datasets including AMI, DIHARD, and VoxConverse, it provides robust voice detection capabilities. Released under MIT license, this specialized tool is designed for speaker diarization, speech processing, and audio analysis applications requiring accurate speech boundary detection.
295815a5d14f52a7.zh: 语音活动检测是pyannote开发的音频处理流程，用于识别音频流中的语音片段。该模型检测语音存在与静默或背景噪声的区别，支持自动语音识别工作流。在AMI、DIHARD和VoxConverse等多个数据集上训练，提供稳健的语音检测能力。采用MIT许可证发布，这个专门工具设计用于说话人日志、语音处理以及需要精确语音边界检测的音频分析应用。适用于会议记录、语音转录等场景。

The model detects when speech is present versus silence or background noise, supporting automatic speech recognition workflows. 44cdee1678a89d62.en: Dolphin-2.9.1-Yi-1.5-34B is a conversational AI model fine-tuned from Yi-1.5-34B base model. It incorporates multiple training datasets including Dolphin-2.9, OpenHermes-2.5, and function-calling datasets. The model supports text generation and conversational applications with autotrain compatibility. Released under Apache 2.0 license, it demonstrates capabilities in code generation, mathematical reasoning, and general conversation. The model is optimized for instruction following and multi-task learning across various domains including programming and mathematical problem solving.
44cdee1678a89d62.zh: Dolphin-2.9.1-Yi-1.5-34B是基于Yi-1.5-34B基础模型微调的对话AI模型。整合了多个训练数据集，包括Dolphin-2.9、OpenHermes-2.5和函数调用数据集。支持文本生成和对话应用，具备自动训练兼容性。采用Apache 2.0许可证发布，在代码生成、数学推理和通用对话方面展现能力。该模型针对指令遵循和多任务学习进行优化，适用于编程、数学问题解决等多个领域。支持复杂的交互场景和专业化任务处理。

2a2d582f280d9343.en: Tiny-Qwen2ForCausalLM-2.5 is a minimal causal language model for testing and development purposes. Based on Qwen2 architecture, this compact model supports text generation and conversational applications. It is designed for internal testing within the TRL framework, providing a lightweight option for causal language modeling experiments. The model includes compatibility with text generation inference and transformers, serving as a baseline for larger Qwen2 model development and evaluation in research and development workflows.
2a2d582f280d9343.zh: Tiny-Qwen2ForCausalLM-2.5是用于测试和开发目的的最小因果语言模型。基于Qwen2架构，这个紧凑模型支持文本生成和对话应用。专为TRL框架内的内部测试设计，为因果语言建模实验提供轻量级选项。该模型包含文本生成推理和transformers兼容性，作为更大Qwen2模型开发和评估的基准，适用于研究和开发工作流中的原型验证和性能测试。

1908c501fc9fe99f.en: Jina-embeddings-v3 is a multilingual text embedding model supporting numerous languages including English, Chinese, Spanish, French, and many others. The model generates semantic representations for text across different languages, enabling cross-lingual similarity and retrieval tasks. It provides dense vector embeddings suitable for semantic search, clustering, and classification applications. The model architecture is optimized for handling diverse linguistic characteristics and supports efficient processing of multilingual content in various natural language processing workflows.
1908c501fc9fe99f.zh: Jina-embeddings-v3是多语言文本嵌入模型，支持包括英语、中文、西班牙语、法语在内的多种语言。该模型为不同语言的文本生成语义表示，实现跨语言相似性和检索任务。提供适用于语义搜索、聚类和分类应用的密集向量嵌入。模型架构针对处理多样化语言特征进行优化，支持在各种自然语言处理工作流中高效处理多语言内容。适用于国际化应用场景和多语言文档分析需求，能够处理复杂的跨语言语义匹配任务。
1908c501fc9fe99f.es: Jina-embeddings-v3 is a multilingual text embedding model supporting numerous languages including English, Chinese, Spanish, French, and many others. It provides dense vector embeddings suitable for semantic search, clustering, and classification applications. The model architecture is optimized for handling diverse linguistic characteristics and supports efficient processing of multilingual content in various natural language processing workflows.

2e8bedc9ca9ef938.en: ESMFold v1 is a protein structure prediction model developed by Facebook, based on evolutionary scale modeling. It uses transformer architecture to predict protein 3D structures from amino acid sequences. The model is compatible with PyTorch and Transformers libraries, licensed under MIT, and available on Hugging Face. It has achieved over 4.5 million downloads and is designed for computational biology applications.
2e8bedc9ca9ef938.zh: ESMFold v1 是由 Facebook 开发的蛋白质结构预测模型，基于进化尺度建模方法。该模型使用 Transformer 架构从氨基酸序列预测蛋白质三维结构，兼容 PyTorch 和 Transformers 库，采用 MIT 许可证，在 Hugging Face 平台上提供。该模型已获得超过 456 万次下载，主要用于计算生物学领域的蛋白质结构预测任务。

7f0f5b6f1383e6e2.en: GTR-T5-base is a sentence embedding model from sentence-transformers that converts text into dense vector representations. Based on T5 architecture, it's designed for semantic similarity tasks and feature extraction. The model supports English language, is Apache 2.0 licensed, and compatible with auto-training and endpoint deployment. It has been downloaded over 4.5 million times for text similarity applications.
7f0f5b6f1383e6e2.zh: GTR-T5-base 是 sentence-transformers 提供的句子嵌入模型，能够将文本转换为密集向量表示。该模型基于 T5 架构设计，专门用于语义相似度计算和特征提取任务，支持英语语言处理，采用 Apache 2.0 许可证，兼容自动训练和端点部署。该模型已累计下载超过 456 万次，广泛应用于文本相似度匹配和语义搜索场景。

b31f23bb1925e051.en: Chronos-bolt-small is a time series forecasting model from AutoGluon, designed as a foundation model for temporal data prediction. Based on T5 architecture, it handles various time series forecasting tasks and is licensed under Apache 2.0. The model supports safe tensor formats and has been downloaded over 4.4 million times for time series analysis applications in different domains.
b31f23bb1925e051.zh: Chronos-bolt-small 是 AutoGluon 开发的时间序列预测基础模型，专门用于时序数据的预测任务。该模型基于 T5 架构构建，能够处理多种时间序列预测场景，采用 Apache 2.0 许可证，支持安全张量格式。该模型已获得超过 446 万次下载，适用于各领域的时间序列分析和预测应用，为时序数据建模提供基础能力。

565a5eff33373133.en: WanVideo_comfy is a diffusion-based video generation model adapted for ComfyUI workflow. It's based on Wan-AI's Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B architecture and provided as a single-file diffusion model. The model focuses on video content generation and has been downloaded over 4.3 million times. It's designed for users working with ComfyUI interface for video creation tasks.
565a5eff33373133.zh: WanVideo_comfy 是基于扩散模型的视频生成工具，专门适配 ComfyUI 工作流程使用。该模型基于 Wan-AI 的 Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B 架构开发，以单文件扩散模型形式提供，专注于视频内容生成任务。该模型已累计下载超过 431 万次，主要为使用 ComfyUI 界面的用户提供视频创作能力，支持各种视频生成应用场景。

d643015ce7336d3a.en: Whisper-large-v3 is OpenAI's large automatic speech recognition model that transcribes speech to text across multiple languages. It supports numerous languages including English, Chinese, Spanish, and many others. The model handles audio processing and speech recognition tasks, licensed for research use. With over 4.3 million downloads, it's widely used for transcription and speech-to-text applications.
d643015ce7336d3a.zh: Whisper-large-v3 是 OpenAI 开发的大型自动语音识别模型，能够将语音转换为文本，支持多种语言包括英语、中文、西班牙语等。该模型专门处理音频数据和语音识别任务，适用于研究用途。该模型已获得超过 430 万次下载，广泛应用于语音转录和语音转文本场景，为多语言语音识别提供高质量的解码能力。

6978bd937a27fb51.en: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct is a 7-billion parameter multimodal model from Qwen that processes both images and text. It supports visual question answering, image captioning, and conversational tasks. The model is Apache 2.0 licensed, compatible with text generation inference, and has been downloaded over 4.2 million times. It's designed for vision-language understanding and generation applications.
6978bd937a27fb51.zh: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 是 Qwen 开发的 70 亿参数多模态模型，能够同时处理图像和文本信息。该模型支持视觉问答、图像描述生成和对话任务，采用 Apache 2.0 许可证，兼容文本生成推理。该模型已累计下载超过 427 万次，专门用于视觉语言理解和生成应用，为多模态人工智能任务提供强大的视觉语言处理能力。

9e40975699339a39.en: freeCodeCamp is an open-source educational platform offering a comprehensive curriculum for learning programming, computer science, and mathematics. The project provides free coding lessons, interactive exercises, and certification programs covering technologies like JavaScript, Node.js, React, and D3. It serves as both a learning resource and community platform for aspiring developers, with content available in multiple languages and formats to support self-paced education.

8ce8e1f97fd2f197.en: React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces, particularly for web applications. Developed by Facebook, it enables component-based development with a declarative programming model. React facilitates the creation of interactive UIs through its virtual DOM implementation and efficient rendering system. The library supports both web and native mobile development through React Native. It includes features like state management, lifecycle methods, and hooks for functional components.
8ce8e1f97fd2f197.zh: React是一个用于构建用户界面的JavaScript库，特别适用于Web应用程序。由Facebook开发，它采用声明式编程模型支持基于组件的开发。React通过虚拟DOM实现和高效的渲染系统促进交互式用户界面的创建。该库通过React Native支持Web和原生移动开发。它包含状态管理、生命周期方法和函数组件钩子等特性，提供灵活的组件组合和可重用的UI元素构建方式。

e8a7024662ada638.en: Vue.js is a progressive JavaScript framework for building user interfaces. Its core purpose is to provide an approachable, versatile framework for web development. Key capabilities include reactive data binding, component-based architecture, and virtual DOM rendering. Major strengths include gentle learning curve, excellent documentation, and flexible integration options. Vue excels in single-page applications, interactive web interfaces, and can scale from simple widgets to complex enterprise applications. The framework emphasizes developer experience with intuitive APIs and comprehensive tooling support.
e8a7024662ada638.zh: Vue.js 是一个渐进式 JavaScript 框架，用于构建用户界面。其核心目的是为 Web 开发提供易学易用且功能强大的解决方案。主要能力包括响应式数据绑定、组件化架构和虚拟 DOM 渲染。显著优势在于学习曲线平缓、文档完善、集成灵活。Vue 特别适用于单页应用、交互式 Web 界面，能够从简单组件扩展到复杂企业级应用。该框架强调开发者体验，提供直观的 API 和完整的工具链支持，支持逐步采用和与其他库的协同使用。

Strengths include community-driven development, well-documented code, and coverage of both basic and advanced algorithms. Typical use cases include academic study, interview preparation, algorithm practice, and reference for implementing common computational methods in Python projects.

d4118cf08141dace.en: TensorFlow is an open-source machine learning framework designed for building and deploying ML models. Its core capabilities include flexible computation graphs, distributed training across multiple devices, and deployment on various platforms from mobile to cloud. Key strengths are its scalability for production systems, extensive library of pre-built models, and support for both research and industrial applications. Typical use cases span computer vision, natural language processing, recommendation systems, and predictive analytics across diverse industries.

9bbeb4eab6136868.en: The Book of Secret Knowledge is a comprehensive collection of technical resources for IT professionals, particularly in security, DevOps, and system administration. It contains curated lists, manuals, cheatsheets, blogs, tools, and practical one-liners covering Linux, hacking, pentesting, and operational guidelines. The project serves as a centralized reference for security researchers, sysops, and developers seeking quick access to proven techniques and tools. Its strength lies in the breadth of practical knowledge compiled from various sources, organized for efficient reference and daily use in technical operations.

6b0ed5aae3f26553.en: Oh My Zsh is a community-driven framework for managing Zsh shell configurations. It provides over 300 plugins for various tools and platforms including Git, Docker, Python, and Node.js, plus 140+ themes for terminal customization. The project includes auto-update functionality and has contributions from more than 2,400 developers. It serves as a comprehensive tool for enhancing command-line productivity and shell environment management.
6b0ed5aae3f26553.zh: Oh My Zsh 是一个社区驱动的 Zsh shell 配置管理框架。该项目提供 300 多个插件，支持 Git、Docker、Python、Node.js 等多种工具和平台，以及 140 多种终端主题。包含自动更新功能，拥有 2400 多名贡献者参与开发。作为增强命令行生产力和 shell 环境管理的综合工具，它帮助用户快速配置和个性化终端体验。

99e4be1c33e0df20.en: Visual Studio Code is a source code editor developed by Microsoft. Built with Electron and TypeScript, it provides features including debugging support, syntax highlighting, intelligent code completion, snippets, and code refactoring. The editor supports various programming languages and includes Git integration. It offers extensive customization through extensions and is available for Windows, macOS, and Linux platforms.
99e4be1c33e0df20.zh: Visual Studio Code 是微软开发的源代码编辑器。基于 Electron 和 TypeScript 构建，提供调试支持、语法高亮、智能代码补全、代码片段和重构等功能。支持多种编程语言，集成 Git 版本控制。通过扩展机制实现高度定制化，可在 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台上运行。
99e4be1c33e0df20.es: Visual Studio Code is a source code editor developed by Microsoft. Built with Electron and TypeScript, it provides features including debugging support, syntax highlighting, intelligent code completion, snippets, and code refactoring. The editor supports various programming languages and includes Git integration. It offers extensive customization through extensions and is available for Windows, macOS, and Linux platforms.

25a87e07b5289568.en: Bootstrap is a popular open-source front-end framework for developing responsive, mobile-first websites. It provides HTML, CSS, and JavaScript components for typography, forms, buttons, navigation, and other interface elements. The framework includes a responsive grid system, prebuilt components, and powerful plugins. Built with Sass, it allows customization and theming while ensuring cross-browser compatibility and responsive design principles.
25a87e07b5289568.zh: Bootstrap 是一个流行的开源前端框架，用于开发响应式、移动优先的网站。提供 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript 组件，包括排版、表单、按钮、导航等界面元素。框架包含响应式网格系统、预构建组件和强大插件。基于 Sass 构建，支持自定义和主题化，确保跨浏览器兼容性和响应式设计原则。
25a87e07b5289568.es: Bootstrap is a popular open-source front-end framework for developing responsive, mobile-first websites. It provides HTML, CSS, and JavaScript components for typography, forms, buttons, navigation, and other interface elements. The framework includes a responsive grid system, prebuilt components, and powerful plugins. Built with Sass, it allows customization and theming while ensuring cross-browser compatibility and responsive design principles.

9a551b9caa42683e.en: Flutter is Google's open-source UI software development kit for building natively compiled applications. It enables cross-platform development for mobile, web, and desktop from a single codebase. Using the Dart programming language, Flutter provides a rich set of pre-designed widgets following Material Design and Cupertino styles. The framework features hot reload for rapid development and delivers high performance through its own rendering engine.
9a551b9caa42683e.zh: Flutter 是谷歌开源的 UI 软件开发工具包，用于构建原生编译的应用程序。支持从单一代码库进行移动端、网页和桌面端的跨平台开发。使用 Dart 编程语言，提供丰富的预设计组件，遵循 Material Design 和 Cupertino 风格。框架具备热重载功能以实现快速开发，并通过自有渲染引擎提供高性能表现。

It enables cross-platform development for mobile, web, and desktop from a single codebase. Using the Dart programming language, Flutter provides a rich set of pre-designed widgets following Material Design and Cupertino styles. The framework features hot reload for rapid development and delivers high performance through its own rendering engine.

b135c074a1f36491.en: GitHub's gitignore repository is a collection of .gitignore templates for various programming languages, frameworks, and development environments. These templates help exclude unnecessary files from version control, such as build artifacts, temporary files, and environment-specific configurations. The collection covers popular technologies and tools, providing standardized ignore patterns to maintain clean Git repositories and prevent accidental commits of irrelevant files.
b135c074a1f36491.zh: GitHub 的 gitignore 仓库收集了各种编程语言、框架和开发环境的 .gitignore 模板。这些模板帮助从版本控制中排除不必要的文件，如构建产物、临时文件和特定环境配置。集合涵盖流行技术和工具，提供标准化的忽略模式，以维护整洁的 Git 仓库并防止意外提交无关文件。

These templates help exclude unnecessary files from version control, such as build artifacts, temporary files, and environment-specific configurations. The collection covers popular technologies and tools, providing standardized ignore patterns to maintain clean Git repositories and prevent accidental commits of irrelevant files.

2ce75a464e9cfca1.en: Stable Diffusion web UI is a browser-based interface for the Stable Diffusion AI image generation model. It provides a graphical interface for text-to-image and image-to-image generation, upscaling, and other AI art creation tasks. Built with Gradio, the web interface makes Stable Diffusion accessible without command-line usage. The project supports various models and extensions, enabling users to generate and manipulate images through an intuitive web-based interface.
2ce75a464e9cfca1.zh: Stable Diffusion web UI 是基于浏览器的 Stable Diffusion AI 图像生成模型界面。提供文本到图像、图像到图像生成、放大和其他 AI 艺术创作任务的图形界面。使用 Gradio 构建的网页界面使 Stable Diffusion 无需命令行即可使用。项目支持多种模型和扩展，使用户能够通过直观的基于网页的界面生成和处理图像。

The project supports various models and extensions, enabling users to generate and manipulate images through an intuitive web-based interface.

78007b2ff93224a0.en: Awesome Go is a curated collection of Go frameworks, libraries, and software. It serves as a comprehensive resource for developers working with the Go programming language. It includes various categories of Go tools and resources, making it valuable for both beginners and experienced Go programmers seeking reliable packages and development tools.

4303081a8ba24016.en: Microsoft Activation Scripts is an open-source tool for activating Windows and Office products. With over 150,000 GitHub stars, it offers various techniques for product activation while maintaining an open-source approach. The tool addresses activation requirements for different Windows and Office versions through its comprehensive method selection.

The tool addresses activation requirements for different Windows and Office versions through its comprehensive method selection.

fcd7a41db2e9250d.en: Airbnb JavaScript Style Guide is a comprehensive coding standard for JavaScript development. It covers ES2015+ features, naming conventions, and best practices for writing maintainable JavaScript code. The guide includes linting rules and style recommendations for modern JavaScript development. With nearly 147,500 GitHub stars, it serves as a widely adopted reference for JavaScript coding standards. It addresses various aspects of JavaScript programming including arrow functions, ES6+ features, and code organization patterns for production applications.
fcd7a41db2e9250d.zh: Airbnb JavaScript 风格指南是一个全面的 JavaScript 开发编码标准。该指南涵盖了 ES2015+ 特性、命名约定以及编写可维护 JavaScript 代码的最佳实践。包含适用于现代 JavaScript 开发的代码检查规则和风格建议，在 GitHub 上拥有近 14.7 万星标，是被广泛采用的 JavaScript 编码标准参考。指南涉及 JavaScript 编程的多个方面，包括箭头函数、ES6+ 特性以及生产环境应用的代码组织模式，帮助团队保持代码一致性和质量。
fcd7a41db2e9250d.es: Airbnb JavaScript Style Guide is a comprehensive coding standard for JavaScript development. It covers ES2015+ features, naming conventions, and best practices for writing maintainable JavaScript code. The guide includes linting rules and style recommendations for modern JavaScript development. With nearly 147,500 GitHub stars, it serves as a widely adopted reference for JavaScript coding standards. It addresses various aspects of JavaScript programming including arrow functions, ES6+ features, and code organization patterns for production applications.

6248e994a55187c7.en: youtube-dl is a command-line program designed to download videos from YouTube and numerous other video platforms. Its core capability involves extracting video and audio content from supported sites, converting formats, and selecting quality options. Strengths include extensive site compatibility, regular updates to counter platform changes, and open-source transparency. Typical use cases encompass archiving content, offline viewing, research, and educational purposes where direct downloading is needed.
6248e994a55187c7.zh: youtube-dl 是一个命令行程序，专门用于从 YouTube 及众多其他视频网站下载视频。其核心功能包括从支持的站点提取视频和音频内容、转换格式以及选择质量选项。优势在于广泛的网站兼容性、定期更新以应对平台变更以及开源透明度。典型应用场景包括内容存档、离线观看、研究和教育用途，适用于需要直接下载视频的场合。
6248e994a55187c7.es: youtube-dl is a command-line program designed to download videos from YouTube and numerous other video platforms. Its core capability involves extracting video and audio content from supported sites, converting formats, and selecting quality options. Strengths include extensive site compatibility, regular updates to counter platform changes, and open-source transparency. Typical use cases encompass archiving content, offline viewing, research, and educational purposes where direct downloading is needed.

b23fdce6ed690b4a.en: Next.js is a React-based framework for building web applications. Its primary purpose is to enable server-side rendering and static site generation for React applications. Core capabilities include automatic code splitting, optimized performance, and simplified deployment. Key strengths are hybrid rendering options, built-in CSS support, and API routes. Typical use cases range from static blogs and marketing sites to complex web applications requiring SEO optimization and fast initial loading.
b23fdce6ed690b4a.zh: Next.js 是基于 React 的 Web 应用开发框架，主要用于实现 React 应用的服务器端渲染和静态站点生成。核心功能包括自动代码分割、性能优化和简化部署流程。主要优势在于提供混合渲染选项、内置 CSS 支持和 API 路由功能。典型应用场景涵盖静态博客、营销网站，以及需要搜索引擎优化和快速初始加载的复杂 Web 应用程序。该框架特别适合需要兼顾开发效率和运行时性能的项目。
b23fdce6ed690b4a.es: Next.js is a React-based framework for building web applications. Its primary purpose is to enable server-side rendering and static site generation for React applications. Core capabilities include automatic code splitting, optimized performance, and simplified deployment. Key strengths are hybrid rendering options, built-in CSS support, and API routes. Typical use cases range from static blogs and marketing sites to complex web applications requiring SEO optimization and fast initial loading.

610debb10351bfe0.en: This GitHub repository curates a comprehensive collection of ChatGPT prompts to enhance user interaction with ChatGPT and other large language models. It provides structured prompt templates across various domains including creative writing, technical assistance, role-playing scenarios, and educational applications. The collection helps users formulate more effective queries, explore diverse use cases, and maximize the capabilities of AI language models through proven prompt patterns and techniques.
610debb10351bfe0.zh: 该项目是一个GitHub仓库，专门收集和整理用于ChatGPT及其他大型语言模型的优质提示词模板。核心功能包括提供结构化提示词框架，涵盖创意写作、技术协助、角色扮演、教育应用等多个领域。主要优势在于帮助用户更有效地构建查询指令，探索多样化应用场景，通过经过验证的提示模式和技术充分发挥AI语言模型的潜力。典型使用场景包括内容创作、学习辅助、技术问题解决和对话交互优化。
610debb10351bfe0.es: This GitHub repository curates a comprehensive collection of ChatGPT prompts to enhance user interaction with ChatGPT and other large language models. It provides structured prompt templates across various domains including creative writing, technical assistance, role-playing scenarios, and educational applications. The collection helps users formulate more effective queries, explore diverse use cases, and maximize the capabilities of AI language models through proven prompt patterns and techniques.

78ddb511cb723da3.en: The Tech Interview Handbook provides comprehensive coding interview preparation materials for software engineers. It covers algorithm questions, system design concepts, and behavioral interview techniques. The repository includes curated content on data structures, coding patterns, and problem-solving strategies. With over 130,000 stars, it serves as a popular reference for interview practice and preparation. The materials are designed to help engineers efficiently prepare for technical interviews at major tech companies.
78ddb511cb723da3.zh: 技术面试手册为软件工程师提供全面的编程面试准备材料。该项目涵盖算法问题、系统设计概念和行为面试技巧。资源库包含数据结构、编码模式和问题解决策略的精选内容。拥有超过13万星标，成为面试练习和准备的热门参考。材料旨在帮助工程师高效准备大型科技公司的技术面试，包括编码挑战、系统架构讨论和职业发展指导。内容组织清晰，适合不同经验水平的开发者使用。
78ddb511cb723da3.es: The Tech Interview Handbook provides comprehensive coding interview preparation materials for software engineers. It covers algorithm questions, system design concepts, and behavioral interview techniques. The repository includes curated content on data structures, coding patterns, and problem-solving strategies. With over 130,000 stars, it serves as a popular reference for interview practice and preparation. The materials are designed to help engineers efficiently prepare for technical interviews at major tech companies.

c52bc79dad9b4567.en: Go is a statically typed, compiled programming language designed at Google for building reliable and efficient software. Its core capabilities include built-in concurrency support with goroutines and channels, fast compilation, garbage collection, and strong standard library. Key strengths are excellent performance, simple syntax, cross-platform compilation, and robust tooling. Typical use cases include web servers, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, command-line tools, and network services where high concurrency and performance are essential.
c52bc79dad9b4567.zh: Go 是由 Google 设计的静态类型编译型编程语言，旨在构建可靠高效的软件。其核心能力包括内置的 goroutine 和 channel 并发支持、快速编译、垃圾回收以及强大的标准库。主要优势在于卓越的性能、简洁语法、跨平台编译能力和完善的工具链。典型应用场景包括需要高并发和高性能的 Web 服务器、分布式系统、云基础设施、命令行工具及网络服务，特别适合现代大规模后端系统开发。
c52bc79dad9b4567.es: Go is a statically typed, compiled programming language designed at Google for building reliable and efficient software. Its core capabilities include built-in concurrency support with goroutines and channels, fast compilation, garbage collection, and strong standard library. Key strengths are excellent performance, simple syntax, cross-platform compilation, and robust tooling. Typical use cases include web servers, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, command-line tools, and network services where high concurrency and performance are essential.

168aa2d2c910237b.en: scrcpy is an open-source application for mirroring and controlling Android devices via USB or TCP/IP. It streams the device screen to a computer with minimal latency and allows full control using the computer's keyboard and mouse. Core capabilities include screen mirroring, device control, audio forwarding, and screen recording. Strengths include high performance, low resource usage, and no need for root access. Typical use cases include app development, presentations, gaming, and remote device management.
168aa2d2c910237b.zh: scrcpy 是一款开源应用程序，用于通过 USB 或 TCP/IP 镜像和控制 Android 设备。它将设备屏幕流式传输到计算机，延迟极低，并允许使用计算机的键盘和鼠标进行完全控制。核心功能包括屏幕镜像、设备控制、音频转发和屏幕录制。优势在于高性能、低资源消耗且无需 root 权限。典型应用场景包括应用开发、演示、游戏和远程设备管理。
168aa2d2c910237b.es: scrcpy is an open-source application for mirroring and controlling Android devices via USB or TCP/IP. It streams the device screen to a computer with minimal latency and allows full control using the computer's keyboard and mouse. Core capabilities include screen mirroring, device control, audio forwarding, and screen recording. Strengths include high performance, low resource usage, and no need for root access. Typical use cases include app development, presentations, gaming, and remote device management.

43a03e94dff3d67a.en: yt-dlp is a Python-based command-line audio and video downloader that extends youtube-dl with additional features. It supports downloading from numerous sites, offers sponsor blocking via SponsorBlock integration, and provides enhanced extraction capabilities. The tool is actively maintained with frequent updates to handle site changes and new features. It includes options for format selection, metadata embedding, and post-processing tasks.
43a03e94dff3d67a.zh: yt-dlp 是一个基于 Python 的命令行音视频下载工具，扩展了 youtube-dl 的功能。它支持从众多网站下载内容，通过 SponsorBlock 集成提供赞助商屏蔽功能，并具备增强的提取能力。该工具积极维护，频繁更新以应对网站变更和新功能。包含格式选择、元数据嵌入和后处理任务等选项，适用于批量下载和自动化场景。
43a03e94dff3d67a.es: yt-dlp is a Python-based command-line audio and video downloader that extends youtube-dl with additional features. It supports downloading from numerous sites, offers sponsor blocking via SponsorBlock integration, and provides enhanced extraction capabilities. The tool is actively maintained with frequent updates to handle site changes and new features. It includes options for format selection, metadata embedding, and post-processing tasks.

41a31595d2a07b0e.en: 30-seconds-of-code is an educational repository containing concise JavaScript code snippets and programming articles. It focuses on practical examples that can be understood in 30 seconds or less, covering ES6+ features, algorithms, and common programming patterns. The collection serves as a learning resource for developers to quickly grasp concepts and improve their coding skills across various web technologies including HTML, CSS, and Node.js.
41a31595d2a07b0e.zh: 30-seconds-of-code 是一个教育性代码库，包含简洁的 JavaScript 代码片段和编程文章。专注于可在 30 秒内理解的实用示例，涵盖 ES6+ 特性、算法和常见编程模式。该合集作为开发者的学习资源，帮助快速掌握概念并提升编码技能，涉及 HTML、CSS 和 Node.js 等多种 Web 技术。内容按主题分类，便于查找和参考。
41a31595d2a07b0e.es: 30-seconds-of-code is an educational repository containing concise JavaScript code snippets and programming articles. It focuses on practical examples that can be understood in 30 seconds or less, covering ES6+ features, algorithms, and common programming patterns. The collection serves as a learning resource for developers to quickly grasp concepts and improve their coding skills across various web technologies including HTML, CSS, and Node.js.

a3a8b88c39bcb24c.en: Langflow is a visual tool for building and deploying AI-powered agents and workflows using large language models. It provides a drag-and-drop interface based on React Flow for creating complex AI applications without extensive coding. The platform supports multi-agent systems and integration with various AI models, enabling users to design, test, and deploy custom AI solutions for tasks like chatbots, automation, and data processing.
a3a8b88c39bcb24c.zh: Langflow 是一个可视化工具，用于使用大语言模型构建和部署 AI 驱动的智能体和 workflow。它提供基于 React Flow 的拖放界面，无需大量编码即可创建复杂的 AI 应用。该平台支持多智能体系统和多种 AI 模型集成，使用户能够设计、测试和部署自定义 AI 解决方案，适用于聊天机器人、自动化和数据处理等任务。界面直观，适合不同技术水平的用户。
a3a8b88c39bcb24c.es: Langflow is a visual tool for building and deploying AI-powered agents and workflows using large language models. It provides a drag-and-drop interface based on React Flow for creating complex AI applications without extensive coding. The platform supports multi-agent systems and integration with various AI models, enabling users to design, test, and deploy custom AI solutions for tasks like chatbots, automation, and data processing.

4201936008f3fb4c.en: React Native is an open-source framework developed by Facebook for building native mobile applications using React and JavaScript. It enables developers to create cross-platform apps for iOS and Android with a single codebase while maintaining native performance and user experience. The framework provides access to platform-specific APIs and components, allowing for the development of fully functional mobile applications with shared business logic across different operating systems.
4201936008f3fb4c.zh: React Native 是 Facebook 开发的开源框架，用于使用 React 和 JavaScript 构建原生移动应用。它使开发者能够用单一代码库创建 iOS 和 Android 的跨平台应用，同时保持原生性能和用户体验。该框架提供对平台特定 API 和组件的访问，允许开发功能完整的移动应用，在不同操作系统间共享业务逻辑。支持热重载和丰富的第三方库生态系统。
4201936008f3fb4c.es: React Native is an open-source framework developed by Facebook for building native mobile applications using React and JavaScript. It enables developers to create cross-platform apps for iOS and Android with a single codebase while maintaining native performance and user experience. The framework provides access to platform-specific APIs and components, allowing for the development of fully functional mobile applications with shared business logic across different operating systems.

3407bcd9b975acef.en: Microsoft PowerToys is a collection of system utilities for Windows that enhance productivity and customization. It includes tools like FancyZones for window management, PowerRename for batch file renaming, Color Picker for color selection, and Keyboard Manager for key remapping. These utilities help users streamline daily tasks, improve workflow efficiency, and personalize their Windows experience without requiring advanced technical knowledge or third-party software installations.
3407bcd9b975acef.zh: Microsoft PowerToys 是 Windows 的系统工具集合，用于提升生产力和自定义功能。包含 FancyZones 窗口管理工具、PowerRename 批量文件重命名、Color Picker 颜色选择器和 Keyboard Manager 键盘重映射等实用程序。这些工具帮助用户简化日常任务，提高工作流程效率，并个性化 Windows 体验，无需高级技术知识或安装第三方软件。支持 Windows 10 和 11 系统。
3407bcd9b975acef.es: Microsoft PowerToys is a collection of system utilities for Windows that enhance productivity and customization. It includes tools like FancyZones for window management, PowerRename for batch file renaming, Color Picker for color selection, and Keyboard Manager for key remapping. These utilities help users streamline daily tasks, improve workflow efficiency, and personalize their Windows experience without requiring advanced technical knowledge or third-party software installations.

5a51344b176eb187.en: Electron is an open-source framework for building cross-platform desktop applications using web technologies like JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. It combines the Chromium rendering engine with Node.js runtime, allowing developers to create native-like desktop apps for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Applications built with Electron package web content into executable desktop programs while providing access to native operating system APIs and features through JavaScript interfaces.
5a51344b176eb187.zh: Electron 是一个开源框架，用于使用 JavaScript、HTML 和 CSS 等 Web 技术构建跨平台桌面应用。它将 Chromium 渲染引擎与 Node.js 运行时结合，使开发者能够为 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 创建类似原生的桌面程序。基于 Electron 的应用将 Web 内容打包成可执行桌面程序，同时通过 JavaScript 接口提供对原生操作系统 API 和功能的访问。广泛应用于各种桌面软件开发。
5a51344b176eb187.es: Electron is an open-source framework for building cross-platform desktop applications using web technologies like JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. It combines the Chromium rendering engine with Node.js runtime, allowing developers to create native-like desktop apps for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Applications built with Electron package web content into executable desktop programs while providing access to native operating system APIs and features through JavaScript interfaces.

f978572b75e44975.en: Kubernetes is an open-source container orchestration platform for automating deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications. Developed by the Cloud Native Computing Foundation, it provides production-grade container scheduling capabilities. Written in Go, it handles container lifecycle management across clusters of hosts, offering service discovery, load balancing, storage orchestration, automated rollouts and rollbacks, and self-healing capabilities for applications.
f978572b75e44975.zh: Kubernetes 是一个开源的容器编排平台，用于自动化部署、扩展和管理容器化应用程序。由云原生计算基金会开发，提供生产级的容器调度能力。使用 Go 语言编写，能够跨主机集群管理容器生命周期，为应用程序提供服务发现、负载均衡、存储编排、自动部署和回滚以及自我修复功能。该项目在 GitHub 上拥有超过 11 万星标和 4 万多次分支。
f978572b75e44975.es: Kubernetes is an open-source container orchestration platform for automating deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications. Developed by the Cloud Native Computing Foundation, it provides production-grade container scheduling capabilities. Written in Go, it handles container lifecycle management across clusters of hosts, offering service discovery, load balancing, storage orchestration, automated rollouts and rollbacks, and self-healing capabilities for applications.

8c411210a1615c27.en: LangChain is a Python framework for developing applications powered by language models. It enables building context-aware reasoning applications that can interact with various data sources and tools. The framework supports integration with multiple AI providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Gemini. It provides components for prompt management, memory, chains, and agents to create sophisticated LLM-powered applications with reasoning capabilities across different contexts and data types.
8c411210a1615c27.zh: LangChain 是一个用于开发语言模型驱动应用程序的 Python 框架。它支持构建能够与各种数据源和工具交互的上下文感知推理应用程序。该框架集成了多个 AI 提供商，包括 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Google Gemini。它提供提示管理、记忆、链和代理等组件，用于创建跨不同上下文和数据类型的复杂 LLM 驱动应用程序。该项目在 GitHub 上获得超过 11 万星标和 1.9 万次分支。
8c411210a1615c27.es: LangChain is a Python framework for developing applications powered by language models. It enables building context-aware reasoning applications that can interact with various data sources and tools. The framework supports integration with multiple AI providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Gemini. It provides components for prompt management, memory, chains, and agents to create sophisticated LLM-powered applications with reasoning capabilities across different contexts and data types.

ce4b614bceccba64.en: D3.js is a JavaScript library for creating dynamic, interactive data visualizations in web browsers. It uses web standards like SVG, Canvas, and HTML to bring data to life through charts, graphs, and other visual representations. The library provides powerful data-driven transformations of the Document Object Model, enabling developers to bind arbitrary data to DOM elements and apply data-driven transformations. It emphasizes web standards and provides capabilities for complex visualization techniques while maintaining full control over the final visual output.
ce4b614bceccba64.zh: D3.js 是一个用于在 Web 浏览器中创建动态交互式数据可视化的 JavaScript 库。它使用 SVG、Canvas 和 HTML 等 Web 标准，通过图表、图形和其他视觉表现形式让数据变得生动。该库提供强大的数据驱动文档对象模型转换功能，使开发人员能够将任意数据绑定到 DOM 元素并应用数据驱动的转换。它强调 Web 标准，提供复杂可视化技术的能力，同时保持对最终视觉输出的完全控制。该项目在 GitHub 上有超过 11 万星标和 2.2 万次分支。
ce4b614bceccba64.es: D3.js is a JavaScript library for creating dynamic, interactive data visualizations in web browsers. It uses web standards like SVG, Canvas, and HTML to bring data to life through charts, graphs, and other visual representations. The library provides powerful data-driven transformations of the Document Object Model, enabling developers to bind arbitrary data to DOM elements and apply data-driven transformations. It emphasizes web standards and provides capabilities for complex visualization techniques while maintaining full control over the final visual output.

f98b5e175b9d6d97.en: Three.js is a cross-browser JavaScript library and API used to create and display animated 3D computer graphics in a web browser. It uses WebGL, WebGPU, Canvas, and SVG renderers to create 3D scenes that run in browsers without plugins. The library supports various 3D features including geometries, materials, lights, cameras, and animations. It enables development of 3D applications, games, data visualizations, and virtual/augmented reality experiences that can run directly in web browsers across different devices and platforms.
f98b5e175b9d6d97.zh: Three.js 是一个跨浏览器 JavaScript 库和 API，用于在 Web 浏览器中创建和显示动画 3D 计算机图形。它使用 WebGL、WebGPU、Canvas 和 SVG 渲染器来创建在浏览器中无需插件即可运行的 3D 场景。该库支持各种 3D 功能，包括几何体、材质、灯光、相机和动画。它能够开发 3D 应用程序、游戏、数据可视化以及虚拟/增强现实体验，这些应用可以直接在不同设备和平台的 Web 浏览器中运行。该项目在 GitHub 上拥有超过 10 万星标和 3.6 万次分支。
f98b5e175b9d6d97.es: Three.js is a cross-browser JavaScript library and API used to create and display animated 3D computer graphics in a web browser. It uses WebGL, WebGPU, Canvas, and SVG renderers to create 3D scenes that run in browsers without plugins. The library supports various 3D features including geometries, materials, lights, cameras, and animations. It enables development of 3D applications, games, data visualizations, and virtual/augmented reality experiences that can run directly in web browsers across different devices and platforms.

77bc5142c147d98a.en: Axios is a promise-based HTTP client for JavaScript that works in both browser and Node.js environments. It provides a simple API for making HTTP requests and handling responses. The library supports all modern browsers and includes features like request and response interception, automatic JSON data transformation, client-side protection against XSRF, and the ability to cancel requests. It simplifies working with REST APIs and other HTTP services by providing a clean, promise-based interface that handles common HTTP operations and error handling scenarios.
77bc5142c147d98a.zh: Axios 是一个基于 Promise 的 JavaScript HTTP 客户端，可在浏览器和 Node.js 环境中工作。它提供简单的 API 用于发出 HTTP 请求和处理响应。该库支持所有现代浏览器，包含请求和响应拦截、自动 JSON 数据转换、客户端 XSRF 保护以及取消请求的能力等功能。它通过提供清晰的基于 Promise 的接口来处理常见的 HTTP 操作和错误处理场景，从而简化了与 REST API 和其他 HTTP 服务的交互。该项目在 GitHub 上获得超过 10 万星标和 1.1 万次分支。
77bc5142c147d98a.es: Axios is a promise-based HTTP client for JavaScript that works in both browser and Node.js environments. It provides a simple API for making HTTP requests and handling responses. The library supports all modern browsers and includes features like request and response interception, automatic JSON data transformation, client-side protection against XSRF, and the ability to cancel requests. It simplifies working with REST APIs and other HTTP services by providing a clean, promise-based interface that handles common HTTP operations and error handling scenarios.

5d7f0226bd789c20.en: Excalidraw is an open-source virtual whiteboard tool for creating hand-drawn style diagrams and sketches. It provides a collaborative drawing environment where multiple users can work together in real-time. The tool features a simple, intuitive interface that mimics the experience of drawing on physical whiteboards. 5d7f0226bd789c20.zh: Excalidraw 是一个开源的虚拟白板工具，用于创建手绘风格的图表和草图。它提供协作绘图环境，多个用户可以实时共同工作。该工具具有简单直观的界面，模拟在物理白板上绘图的体验。它支持各种绘图元素、形状和文本，并能够导出为多种格式。Excalidraw 强调易用性和协作性，使其适用于个人和团队环境中的头脑风暴、图表绘制和视觉规划会议。该项目在 GitHub 上拥有超过 10 万星标和 1 万次分支。
5d7f0226bd789c20.es: Excalidraw is an open-source virtual whiteboard tool for creating hand-drawn style diagrams and sketches. It provides a collaborative drawing environment where multiple users can work together in real-time. The tool features a simple, intuitive interface that mimics the experience of drawing on physical whiteboards. It supports various drawing elements, shapes, and text, with export capabilities to multiple formats. Excalidraw emphasizes ease of use and collaboration, making it suitable for brainstorming, diagramming, and visual planning sessions in both individual and team settings.
